context_requirements: Cells must express calmodulin-dependent signaling pathways that are active at baseline.
Intact calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinase and phosphatase signaling.
Proliferating cells with intact cell-cycle checkpoints are more likely to show antiproliferative transcriptional responses.
TP53 status may modulate the apoptotic arm but is not required for immediate early gene induction.
falsifiers: No induction of FOS, JUN, EGR1 or other immediate early genes at 6 h in any responsive line.
No decrease in proliferation-associated genes at 24 h despite calmodulin inhibition.
Transcriptional response indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines.
Selective strong response only in lines lacking CALM1 expression, which would argue against on-target calmodulin antagonism.
